120: def build_recommended_commands(
121:     selected_go_packages: set[str],
122:     selected_pytest_files: set[str],
123:     run_full_integration: bool,
124: ) -> dict[str, str]:
125:     return {
126:         "go": (
127:             f"go test {' '.join(sorted(selected_go_packages))}"
128:             if selected_go_packages
129:             else "go test ./..."
130:         ),
131:         "pytest": (
132:             "pytest -v integration-tests"
133:             if run_full_integration
134:             else (
135:                 "pytest -v " + " ".join(sorted(selected_pytest_files))
136:                 if selected_pytest_files
137:                 else "pytest -v integration-tests/test_version.py"
138:             )
139:         ),
140:     }
141:

143: def select_tests(config: dict[str, Any], base: str, head: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
144:     changed_files = git_changed_files(base, head)
145:     ignore_patterns = compile_patterns(config.get("ignore_patterns", []))
146:     docs_patterns = compile_patterns(config.get("docs_only_patterns", []))
147:     fallback_patterns = compile_patterns(config.get("fallback_patterns", []))
148:     go_package_roots = load_go_package_roots(config)
149: 
150:     considered_files = [
151:         path for path in changed_files if not matches_any(path, ignore_patterns)
152:     ]
153:     docs_only_change = bool(considered_files) and all(
154:         matches_any(path, docs_patterns) for path in considered_files
155:     )
156: 
157:     selected_go_packages: set[str] = set()
158:     selected_pytest_files: set[str] = set()
159:     matched_rules: list[str] = []
160:     reasons: list[str] = []
161: 
162:     smoke = config.get("smoke", {})
163:     smoke_go = set(smoke.get("go_packages", []))
164:     smoke_pytest = set(smoke.get("pytest_files", []))
165: 
166:     rule_match_by_file: dict[str, list[str]] = {path: [] for path in considered_files}
167:     for rule in config.get("rules", []):
168:         compiled_rule_patterns = compile_patterns(rule.get("patterns", []))
169:         matched = [
170:             path for path in considered_files if matches_any(path, compiled_rule_patterns)
171:         ]
172:         if not matched:
173:             continue
174:         matched_rules.append(rule["id"])
175:         selected_go_packages.update(rule.get("go_packages", []))
176:         selected_pytest_files.update(rule.get("pytest_files", []))
177:         reasons.append(f"rule:{rule['id']}")
178:         for path in matched:
179:             rule_match_by_file[path].append(rule["id"])
180: 
181:     for path in considered_files:
182:         if path.startswith("integration-tests/test_") and path.endswith(".py"):
183:             selected_pytest_files.add(path)
184:             reasons.append(f"direct-test-file:{path}")
185:         package = normalize_go_package(path, go_package_roots)
186:         if package and not rule_match_by_file[path]:
187:             selected_go_packages.add(package)
188:             reasons.append(f"derived-go-package:{package}")
189: 
190:     full_run_triggers = [
191:         path for path in considered_files if matches_any(path, fallback_patterns)
192:     ]
193:     run_full_integration = bool(full_run_triggers)
194: 
195:     if not considered_files:
196:         run_full_integration = True
197:         reasons.append("no-considered-files")
198: 
199:     if run_full_integration:
200:         reasons.extend(f"full-trigger:{path}" for path in full_run_triggers)
201:     else:
202:         selected_go_packages.update(smoke_go)
203:         # Keep docs-only changes very cheap while still exercising basic CLI output.
204:         selected_pytest_files.update(smoke_pytest)
205:         if docs_only_change:
206:             reasons.append("docs-only-change")
207: 
208:     if run_full_integration:
209:         risk_level = "high"
210:     elif docs_only_change:
211:         risk_level = "low"
212:     else:
213:         risk_level = "medium"
214: 
215:     return {
216:         "base": base,
217:         "head": head,
218:         "changed_files": changed_files,
219:         "considered_files": considered_files,
220:         "docs_only_change": docs_only_change,
221:         "matched_rules": sorted(set(matched_rules)),
222:         "selected_go_packages": sorted(selected_go_packages),
223:         "selected_pytest_files": sorted(selected_pytest_files),
224:         "run_full_integration": run_full_integration,
225:         "risk_level": risk_level,
226:         "reasons": sorted(set(reasons)),
227:         "recommended_commands": build_recommended_commands(
228:             selected_go_packages,
229:             selected_pytest_files,
230:             run_full_integration,
231:         ),
232:     }
